stem.text: A student carried out an investigation into the effect of temperature on the rate of an enzyme-catalysed reaction.
At each temperature, the substrate concentration was measured after 10 minutes. All the other variables were kept constant.
Which graph shows the effect of increasing temperature on the substrate concentration after 10 minutes?

A.alt: Graph of substrate concentration against temperature / °C, with a curve that falls and levels off.

B.alt: Graph of substrate concentration against temperature / °C, with a curve that rises to a peak and then falls sharply.

C.alt: Graph of substrate concentration against temperature / °C, with a curve that rises and levels off.

D.alt: Graph of substrate concentration against temperature / °C, with a curve that falls to a minimum and then rises.
